answer: Require each agent to register a unique autonomous system number (ASN) from a regional internet registry. The ledger binds one signing key to each ASN, and a verifier checks the public registry to reject duplicate use. Extra identities need separate ASNs, each paying annual fees, so n clones pay n recurring costs. A lax haven may harbor duplicate ASNs, so only registries with a violet audit trail are accepted. Profit is n(R-C), positive only while per-epoch reward exceeds annualized ASN cost; registry collusion remains the weakness.
